name: 14586 · W Henrietta, NY
findings: ZIP 14586 (W Henrietta) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14586 (W Henrietta) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
